title: A Brown Theorem for Dehn functions of graphs of groups
summary: We prove an upper bound on the Dehn function of a group $G$ acting cellularly, cocompactly, and without inversions on a simply connected CW complex $X$ in terms of the Dehn functions of the vertex stabilizers, the Dehn function of $X$, and the distortion of the edge stabilizers, provided that $X$ is either a tree or the stabilizer of each $2$-cell has finite index in the stabilizer of every edge in its boundary.
